text:
sarah-cs: Quick week0 sync for Mistral private cutover. Three immediate blockers: their KMS key policy doesn't include our service role (causing decrypt failures), VPC only allows public egress so we can't reach internal proxies, and audit logs (Splunk) aren't arriving. Need owners + ETA.

mike-netops: I pulled their SGs 10m ago. Outbound is 0.0.0.0/0 on 443/80 only. We need 10.100.0.0/16 allowed to our egress proxies and 10.100.1.0/24 for health checks. Also their NAT IP is ephemeral 1. Ask for static jump NAT. @jules-engr what ports do health-checks use?

jules-engr: Health checks = TCP 8080 and 9090 (internal). Splunk HF needs TCP 9997. If they still use syslog (unlikely) we'd need UDP 514 too. For canary we need a jump host with a stable public NAT to run probes.

sarah-cs: @rachel-customer can you confirm Splunk endpoint and jump NAT IP please?

rachel-customer: splunk-prod.mistral:9997 1 I'll open 9997 to your account. Temporary jump NAT IP: 203.0.113.42.

alice-kms: KMS findings: their key policy omitted arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/redwood-infer-role so our decrypt tests fail with AccessDenied. Minimal allow entry required: Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey for our role. Draft snippet below for them to apply.

alice-kms: ```json
{\n  "Effect": "Allow",\n  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/redwood-infer-role" },\n  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],\n  "Resource": "*"\n}
```

jules-engr: That looks fine. Once applied we should re-run integration and rotation tests. Also make sure CloudTrail is capturing kms:Decrypt and forwarding to audit bucket.

mike-netops: Also VPC Flow Logs are disabled. Request: create S3 bucket with prefix redwood-audit and grant our audit role PutObject. Need bucket ARN to add to our ingestion config.

rachel-customer: Creating bucket now: mistral-redwood-audit-prod. Will DM ARN + role names.

sarah-cs: Two things: 1) If KMS policy and SG updates happen today we can run a controlled canary tomorrow. 2) Renewal risk flagged by CSM: timeline slip >7 days triggers commercial review. Escalating to renewal owner.

sarah-cs: Action owners: mike -> apply SG/NAT mapping and confirm; alice -> open PR for KMS policy + test plan; jules -> schedule canary + rollback; rachel -> send Splunk TCP confirm, jump NAT stable IP, and audit bucket ARN. I'll update renewal tracker and loop in finance if needed.

mike-netops: :thumbsup: With jump NAT IP we can add SG rules and NAT mapping in ~2h.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview:privnet-canary-v2 succeeded in staging. Note: canary shows KMS decrypt OK when policy present. CI: https://ci.redwood/infer/5678

rachel-customer: Policy applied and bucket created. Bucket ARN: arn:aws:s3:::mistral-redwood-audit-prod. Sent account ID + role names via DM.

sarah-cs: Great. Jules, confirm canary window tomorrow 10:00-11:00 PST so ops and SRE can monitor. I'll post invite and runbook.

jules-engr: Confirmed. I'll run canary and watch latency/KPM. Revert criteria: any KPM or latency regression >10% -> rollback using --rollback-to=staging. Will post updates to #eng-oncall.

sarah-cs: Thanks everyone. Capturing this in the onboarding tracker and marking renewal risk owner. Will escalate if slip looks likely. :lock:
